{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Rebirth|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Anivia
|skill        = I
|icon         = Rebirth.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Anivia''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} for 6 seconds and restores all of her {{sti|{{as|health}}}}.
|description2 = While under resurrection, '''Anivia''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and gains {{pp|-40 to 20 for 5|1;5;8;12;15|changedisplay=true}} {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.
|description3 = If '''Anivia''' remains alive by the end of the duration, she is revived with her {{as|'''current''' health}}.
|static       = 240
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* Triggering ''Rebirth'' will break {{tip|tether|tethers}} on '''Anivia'''.
* {{ai|Chronoshift|Zilean}} and {{ii|Guardian Angel}} will take priority over ''Rebirth''.
* If ''Rebirth'' triggers while '''Anivia''' is channeling {{si|Teleport}}, her channel won't be interrupted.
** All other {{tip|channel|channels}} will be interrupted upon triggering ''Rebirth''.
* The following refers for interactions while '''Anivia''' is resurrecting:
{{ct|move=false|cast=false|attack=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=false|interrupts=death}}
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, upon {{tip|death|dying}}, {{ci|Anivia}} will instead revert into an egg. If the egg can survive for a few seconds, she is gloriously {{tip|resurrection|reborn}}.
}}

{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Nether Grasp|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Malzahar
|skill        = R
|icon         = Nether Grasp.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Malzahar}} {{tip|tether|tethers}} to the target enemy champion, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}}. The tether lasts a short time, during which he {{tip|channel|channels}} to {{tip|suppression|suppress}} and {{tip|true sight|reveal}} the target, continually dealing them {{as|magic damage}}.
|blurb2      = Additionally, a ''Null Zone'' is opened beneath the target's location for a few seconds, which continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' {{tip|tether|tethers}} to the target enemy champion, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}}. He then {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} the target and dealing them {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself in the process.
|leveling     = {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|125/10 to 275/10}} {{as|(+ 8% AP)}}}}
|description2 = '''''Malzahar''' will continue to channel as long as the tether is not broken, even if the suppression is removed.''
|icon3        = Null Zone.png
|description3 = Additionally, a ''Null Zone'' is opened beneath the target's location at the time of cast that lasts 5 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to enemies within, capped at 120 per tick against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|10 to 20}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|10/10 to 20/10}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
|description4 = ''Null Zone will persist even if the channel is interrupted.
|target range = 700
|tether radius= 1250
|cooldown     = {{ap|140 to 80}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time    = {{fd|0.005}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = Special
|projectile   = False
|callforhelp  = true
|silence      = true
|notes        = 
* Applies {{tip|persistent damage}} for the {{tip|tether}}, and {{tip|persistent area damage}} additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage|indirect}} to enemies within the ''Null Zone''.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents both the tether and the ''Null Zone'' from appearing, however '''Malzahar''' will continue to ''channel''. [https://www.reddit.com/r/Sivir/comments/g7yt38/if_you_shield_malzahar_ult_he_ironically_gets_ccd/]
* The tether will not break if the target enters a {{tip|zombie state}} or enters {{tip|resurrection}}.
* As long as the target is within the tether radius, they will take the full tether damage over {{fd|2.5}} seconds even if they are not tethered due to the tether being broken early into the channel.{{bug}}
** This occurs regardless of how the tether was broken.
** If the target exits tether range they will stop taking damage, but can be damaged again by the remaining ticks if they re-enter the tether range within the duration.
* Removing the {{tip|suppression}} will also remove the {{tip|true sight|reveal}}.
* '''Malzahar''' places himself onto the ground and interrupts {{tip|airborne|displacements}} affecting him upon starting the ''channel''.
* If a target is currently being affected by ''{{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}}'', casting ''Nether Grasp'' on them will grant 2 stacks toward effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}.{{bug}}
** This is, correctly, not the case if ''Nether Grasp'' is cast before ''Malefic Visions''.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Malzahar''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
** The channel will be interrupted if the tether is broken.
{{ct|channel|attack=Disabled if attacking Nether Grasp target. Otherwise interrupts after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of channeling.|cast=interrupts|move=Disabled for the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Interrupts afterwards.|consume=true|items=interrupts,true,interrupts,false,interrupts|spells=true,interrupts,interrupts,interrupts}}
}}

{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Garden of Thorns|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Zyra
|skill        = I
|icon         = Garden of Thorns.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Zyra}} {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} can be turned into plants by hitting them with her basic abilities. Enemy {{tip|champions}} can step over a {{as|Seed|buzzword2}} to destroy it.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Zyra''' plants one or two {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} nearby that remain for some time.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Zyra''' spawns one or two {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} nearby that last for 30 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} over the surrounding area for 1 second.
|static       = {{pp|13.6 - (13.6-9.05)/17*(x-1) for 20}} 
|description2 = After 1 second, enemy {{tip|champions}} can destroy ''Seeds'' by moving on top of them.
|description3 = '''Zyra''' can only have a total of 8 ''Seeds'' planted at a time, preserving {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} spawned by ''{{ai|Rampant Growth|Zyra}}'' over {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} spawned by ''Garden of Thorns''.
|effect radius= 900
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|spelleffects = 
|notes        = 
* {{Pending for test}}: The pattern/probability of ''Garden of Thorns'' spawning one seed or two.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} in brush and not on top of walls.
* '''Zyra''' tries not to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} too close together and at different angles.
* '''Zyra''' does not plant any {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} if she is concealed within a brush (unless there is an enemy ward in it, in which case it takes her a little longer to plant the {{as|Seed|buzzword}}) or when there is no room for additional ones.
* '''Zyra''' does not plant any {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} if she is within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1400 units of the coordinate points (400, 400) or (14000, 14000), which are roughly at the center of the fountains on {{tip|Summoner's Rift}}.
** These same coordinates may not hold as fountain positions on other maps (e.g. on the {{tip|Arena}} map, the Magma Chamber area overlaps with the second exclusion radius) and may prompt the implementation of this behaviour to be changed in the future.{{bug}}
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} close to an enemy near her.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} under enemy structures only if she is in basic attack range of them.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} on the other side of the wall she is facing and/or standing right next to.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} in the direction she is facing and/or moving.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} near jungle path entrances.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} behind herself when she is walking through the river and there are no jungle path entrances near her.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} between herself and the enemy champion she has vision of (or is heading towards her) in a 45º angle to the left or to the right depending on where on lane she is standing.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} against the inner walls of epic monster pits ({{ui|Dragon}}, {{ui|Rift Herald}}, {{ui|Baron Nashor}})
* '''Zyra''' has a hidden passive that grants her 10% increased {{tip|size}} for {{tt|33 seconds|Estimated}} after having {{cai|Sunlight|Leona}} applied to her.
}}
